text: Who is Teruaki Sato? Japan's Triple Crown slugger posted for MLB. Teruaki Sato is a 27-year-old left-handed-hitting third baseman for Japan's Hanshin Tigers who won the 2026 Central League Triple Crown. He was posted for MLB teams on Nov. 2, 2026, and all 30 clubs can negotiate with him until 5 p.m. ET on Dec. 16, 2026.. Sato entered the MLB posting system on Nov. 2, 2026, together with pitchers Kaima Taira and Hiromi Itoh.. Sato batted .306 with 39 home runs and 106 RBIs in 2026 to win the Triple Crown. In 2025 he was the Central League MVP with 40 homers, 102 RBIs and a .924 OPS, and he won the NPB Golden Glove for defense. Over a six-year NPB career he has an .851 OPS, has hit at least 20 homers in five seasons and has played at least 120 games every year. He also has 262 NPB games in the outfield. He helped Hanshin win the 2023 Japan Series and played for Japan at the 2026 World Baseball Classic. Because he is older than 25, Sato is not limited by international bonus-pool rules. The team that signs him pays Hanshin a release fee based on the size of his contract. Reporter Jon Heyman has linked the Mets, Yankees, Dodgers and Phillies to him. If he does not sign by Dec. 16, he returns to Hanshin for 2027.

When does the new Congress take office? Noon on Jan. 3, 2027. The new Congress takes office at noon on Sunday, Jan. 3, 2027. That is when the 120th Congress, elected in the Nov. 3, 2026, midterms, begins and the terms of the outgoing members end. The 20th Amendment sets Jan. 3 as the date, though Congress can choose a different day by law.. After the Nov. 3, 2026, midterms, in which the AP reported Democrats winning both the House and Senate, many are asking when the new majority actually takes over.. Section 1 of the 20th Amendment says the terms of senators and representatives end "at noon on the 3d day of January" and that "the terms of their successors shall then begin." Section 2 says Congress shall assemble at noon on Jan. 3 "unless they shall by law appoint a different day." Because Jan. 3, 2027, falls on a Sunday, the swearing-in could be moved by law; WSOC-TV noted that since 1995 the latest a Congress has been seated is Jan. 7 (in 1997 and 2003). Democrats won control of both chambers in the 2026 midterms. Until Jan. 3, the outgoing 119th Congress keeps working in a lame duck session that begins Nov. 9, 2026. On its first day, the new House elects a speaker; Rep. Hakeem Jeffries is the front-runner.
